get.summary: Gets a specific initiative field value.
get.description: Requires `view` permission at the `initiativeFieldValue` scope on the field value, on its initiative, or on the initiative's changemaker.

parameters.name: initiativeId
parameters.description: The PDC-generated ID of an initiative.

parameters.name: fieldValueId
parameters.description: The PDC-generated ID of an initiative field value.

404.description: The initiative field value could not be found, or the caller may not view it.

patch.summary: Updates a specific initiative field value.
patch.description: Requires `edit` permission at the `initiativeFieldValue` scope on the field value, on its initiative, or on the initiative's changemaker. Citing a new source additionally requires `reference` permission at the `source` scope on that source.

parameters.name: initiativeId
parameters.description: The PDC-generated ID of an initiative.

parameters.name: fieldValueId
parameters.description: The PDC-generated ID of an initiative field value.

403.description: The caller may view the initiative field value but may not edit it, or may not reference the specified source.

404.description: The initiative field value or source could not be found, or the caller may not view it.
